description: This file contains a utility function 'computeComfortScore' that calculates a 'Can I Go Outside?' comfort score based on weather and air quality parameters such as temperature, wind speed, humidity, air quality index, and UV index.

methods.name: computeComfortScore
methods.description: Calculates a comfort score from weather and air quality parameters, returning a value between 1 and 10 indicating how suitable the conditions are for outdoor activity.
